decisions.reason: As a homepage-promoted extension of the firm's core handcrafted candle-arch business, it carries visible commitment and sunk effort that management is likely to defend.
This is very close to the firm's established Christmas pyramid range and was prominently featured, so dropping it would be hard to justify given the strong fit with existing skills and assortment.

Although more distant from the traditional offer, the firm publicly pushed the electronic music-box line and added related items, which makes management somewhat likely to continue rather than admit the move was mistaken.
Even with a second edition, this is still a niche add-on to the electronic line, with weaker strategic fit and lower standalone commitment than the firm's core wooden products.
This seasonal electronic variant appears more peripheral and less strongly committed than the main handcrafted range, so it is the easiest item to remove if results are not convincing.
A themed Christmas pyramid builds directly on the firm's traditional strengths, and its repeated homepage placement suggests management will persist with it rather than write off the launch.
